raw:
I remember forgetting a dinner guest’s name during an introduction at the front door. I got to the point where I needed to say her name, and my mind just went blank. I knew I should know it, and the harder I tried to remember, the more awkward that pause felt.

She quietly supplied her name, which was kind of her. I was grateful she didn’t make a big thing of it, but I felt embarrassed. I wanted her to feel welcome, and instead I was standing there unable to remember something so basic.
